verdict.rationale: W&B publishes an official MCP server, documented in its own docs and an official GitHub repo, that gives IDEs, coding assistants and chat agents direct access to runs, traces, evaluations and artifacts. The marketing site says coding agents like Claude Code use it to read live production data and run evaluations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and evidence of detailed setup and auth steps in the pack.
